description.create: Enter a transaction manually or use the results of receipt photo analysis.

receipt.title: Analyze receipt
receipt.description: Include up to 2 clearly visible receipts in each photo. Split 3 or more across separate photos. Small or blurry text may slow analysis or reduce accuracy. Check the original receipt and amounts before adding transactions.
receipt.queueLimit: You can select up to {count} photos at once.
receipt.analyzingDescription: Analyzing receipt images. Please wait until analysis finishes before using the screen.

review.unknownWarning: Some analysis results need review. Compare them with the original receipt.

warningCodes.PREVIOUS_PUBLISHED_RATE: The nearest published exchange rate before the transaction date was used.
warningCodes.RATE_UNAVAILABLE: Could not retrieve an exchange rate. Check the conversion again.
warningCodes.CURRENCY_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Check and enter the original currency code.
warningCodes.AMOUNT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Check and enter the original payment amount.
warningCodes.DATE_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Check and enter the exact transaction date.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Check and enter the transaction category.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_CANDIDATES_EMPTY: No active categories were available for AI classification. You can enter one manually.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_CANDIDATES_NOT_DELIVERED: Category suggestions were not sent to the analysis service. Reload them and try again.
warningCodes.UNREADABLE: Compare with the original receipt and enter the information that could not be read.
warningCodes.UNKNOWN_CURRENCY: Could not determine the original currency.
warningCodes.AMBIGUOUS_CURRENCY_SYMBOL: The currency symbol alone does not identify the currency.
warningCodes.INVALID_OR_MISSING_AMOUNT: Check and enter the total payment amount.
warningCodes.INVALID_OR_AMBIGUOUS_DATE: The transaction date is missing or ambiguous. Enter the exact date.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_NOT_IN_ACCOUNT_BOOK: Choose an existing category or enter one manually.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_NEW_SUGGESTION: A new category was suggested based on the receipt.
warningCodes.CATEGORY_FALLBACK_USED: A broad Other category was suggested because classification evidence was insufficient.
warningCodes.INVALID_CATEGORY_SUGGESTION: An invalid category suggestion was replaced with a safe default.
warningCodes.MISSING_MERCHANT: Check the store name and transaction title.
warningCodes.MALFORMED_RECEIPT: Some receipt details could not be read.
warningCodes.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_RECEIPT: Check whether the same receipt appears more than once.
warningCodes.OCR_RECEIPT_BOUNDARIES_UNVERIFIED: OCR could not verify receipt boundaries. Check that each transaction was separated correctly.
warningCodes.OCR_MULTIPLE_OR_UNKNOWN_TOTALS: Several possible payment totals were found, or no total could be confirmed.
warningCodes.ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE: Receipt analysis is unavailable. Please try again later.
warningCodes.OCR_FALLBACK_USED: OCR was used instead of AI image analysis. Check the results.
warningCodes.OCR_LANGUAGE_HINT_LIMITATION: Analysis used the default OCR language, so recognition of other languages may be less accurate.
warningCodes.OCR_AI_UNAVAILABLE_RULE_FALLBACK: Analysis used OCR rules without AI assistance. Compare the results with the original.
warningCodes.NO_RECEIPTS_DETECTED: No receipts found. Try again with a clearer photo.
warningCodes.RECEIPT_LIMIT_REACHED: The receipt limit for a single analysis was reached. Analyze the rest in a new photo.
warningCodes.USER_ADDED_RECEIPT_REGION: You added this receipt candidate from the original photo. Enter the required information and confirm your review of the original.

review.conversionLocked: The type, amount and date of receipt transactions cannot be changed because their exchange rate records must be preserved. You can edit the title, store, category and memo.
review.title: Review receipt transactions
review.description: Review each receipt and select the transactions to add. If you change an amount, currency or transaction date, check the conversion again.
review.analysisCompleted: Analyzed {count} receipts. Review the transaction candidates below.
review.receiptDetails: Receipt payment and exchange rate details
review.bookAmount: Original amount recorded in account book
review.paymentCorrectionHint: Discounts and loyalty points are excluded from the recorded amount. To record money actually paid in advance along with this purchase, change that item to Other payment / unrecorded prepayment. Do not include prepayments already recorded in the account book again.
review.observedPaymentType: Originally analyzed as: {type} · Type corrected by user
review.derivedAmountHint: This amount was calculated from the purchase total and payment details. Correct amounts or the classification of points and prepayments below, then check the conversion again.
review.amountCalculated: Calculated from the current payment details. Check the server conversion before adding the transaction.
review.amountNeedsReview: Check the purchase total and payment details. Their totals must match before you can check the conversion again.
review.categoryHint: Choose an existing category or enter a new name.
review.dateFallback: If no rate is available on the transaction date, the nearest published rate before that date is used.
review.staleConversion: The original details changed. Select Check conversion again to get the latest result.
review.requiredFields: Enter a title, category, valid transaction date, positive original amount and 3-letter currency code.
review.previewFailed: Could not check the conversion. Verify your entries and connection, then try again.
review.registrationFailed: Could not add the selected transactions. Check the entries and exchange rates, then try again. Your transaction candidates are preserved.
review.selectionSummary: {selectedCount} selected · {registrableCount} ready to add · {blockedCount} need review
review.selectRegisterableOnly: Select only items ready to add
review.inlineTitlePending: Apply or cancel the title edit before adding transactions.
review.inlineTitleConflict: The source or title changed while you were editing. Cancel and review the latest item.
review.inlineAmountPending: An amount edit or exchange rate recalculation is still pending. Finish it before adding transactions.
review.inlineAmountFailed: Exchange rate recalculation failed. Your entry is preserved; you can cancel or apply it again.
review.inlineAmountSimpleScope: Edit the purchase total and original currency amount together.
review.inlineAmountSinglePaymentScope: Edit the purchase total and single payment amount together.

inlineAmountDetails.points: A points payment requires detailed review.
inlineAmountDetails.multiple_payments: Multiple payment allocations require detailed review.
inlineAmountDetails.cash_change: Cash and change details require detailed review.
inlineAmountDetails.ambiguous_payment: The payment meaning is unclear and requires detailed review.

review.revisionConflict: The source candidate changed while you were editing. Close this window and reopen the latest item.
review.regionPickerDescription: Drag around one receipt in the original photo. This adds a candidate only and does not save a transaction.
review.sourcePreviewUnavailable: The original preview is unavailable in this session.
review.omitBranch: Confirm no branch is shown on the original
review.confirmSourceReview: Confirm current source and entries reviewed
